name: Devansh Singhania
headline: Gave me absolute clarity on engineering vs data science pathways
comment: The 15-page executive diagnostic broke down my cognitive strengths with stunning precision. It helped me and my parents align on my Class 11 subject combinations without any disagreements.
adminNotes: Verified Class 11 CBSE student from The Heritage School.

name: Aarav Sharma
headline: Ended all tension at home regarding PCM vs Commerce
comment: Before CLARVO’s diagnostic evaluation, my parents and I had weeks of tension about whether I should pick Commerce with Applied Math or Science PCM. The 30-dimension cognitive report proved that my spatial reasoning and abstract logic matched Computer Science engineering far better than finance. Having objective data completely ended the guesswork at home.
adminNotes: Verified ICSE student from Gurugram. Highly detailed feedback on cognitive assessment report.

name: Rhea Sengupta
headline: Essential roadmap for IB Higher Level workload calibration
comment: Selecting IB Higher Levels is high-stakes; if you make one mismatched choice, your university options shrink drastically. CLARVO analyzed my VARK learning style and analytical endurance, guiding me to take Math AA HL and Economics HL without getting overwhelmed. The multi-year roadmap also helped me schedule my Extended Essay early.
adminNotes: DAIS Mumbai student. Demonstrated high engagement with multi-year roadmap module.

name: Kabir Mehta
headline: Pacing diagnostic broke down exact seconds wasted per module
comment: I was plateaued at 1360 on standard practice tests because the adaptive second module kept punishing my time management on vocabulary inference and hard algebra. CLARVO’s diagnostic pacing report broke down the exact seconds I wasted per question type and trained me on Desmos shortcuts. Crossing 1540 unlocked direct merit scholarships.
adminNotes: DPS RK Puram student. 1540 SAT scorer.

name: Ananya Deshmukh
school: The Cathedral and John Connon School
headline: Saved me from following the crowd into blind competitive coaching
comment: Almost everyone in my batch was blindly registering for IIT-JEE coaching just because they scored 90%+ in 9th grade. CLARVO was the first platform that assessed my verbal agility, RIASEC enterprising profile, and career interests. It gave my family complete conviction to choose Commerce with Math, saving me from 2 years of burnout.
adminNotes: Cathedral Mumbai. Clean student testimonial on stream fitment.
